2026-05-07 — Reverie v1.0.0 STABLE shipped. The launch session.

THE ARC (15 commits since e8ed078):
1. Foundation cleanup: codex/store residue swept (b888cea, 33 entries), context.devWorkflow refreshed, npm dev link refreshed, ~/.zshrc cleaned.
2. Bun pre-flight + commit-phase: src/storage.ts type-only Scope re-export, scripts/sea-build.js → `bun build --compile`, esbuild + postject dropped, CI workflow updated, Windows + macOS-x64-cross bug fixes.
3. v1.0.0-beta.2 cut → broken (bun-compile runtime traps) → v1.0.0-beta.3 hot-fix.
4. Issue #111 source fix (zsh completions hyphen).
5. v1.0.0 STABLE cut: deleted the pre-rebrand codexcli-era v1.0.0 placeholder release, bumped, tagged, pushed. Verified end-to-end: brew install, --version, MCP probe, completions parse all clean.

NEXT SESSION — POST-LAUNCH MODE:
The technical product is shipped. Open work is mostly non-engineering:
1. Phase 4 commercial: SeaBear product page (seabear.dev/reverie), consulting tier/pricing, inquiry response template, Reverie for Teams landing.
2. Phase 5 launch comms: blog post (bicameral story + codexCLI → Reverie rebrand narrative), Dogfooding Part Three, GitHub-inbound outreach.
3. Visual identity: logo/wordmark, color palette, marketing site.
4. Optional engineering housekeeping: short-flag audit (context.shortFlagAudit), legacy ccli.rb/ccli-beta.rb cleanup in homebrew-reverie tap, decide whether to switch this project's .mcp.json from rvr-beta to rvr now that stable is out.

DON'T (next bootstrap):
- Re-derive any of the rebrand or Bun work (all shipped).
- Re-do C-bucket sweep (closed in b888cea).
- Run v1.0.0-beta.2 binary (broken, superseded).
- Cut release tags autonomously — user-driven moment.

HANDLED THIS SESSION (don't ask about):
- Bun migration commit-phase (DONE, in stable).
- Codex residue sweep (DONE).
- Shell environment cleanup (DONE).
- Issue #111 source fix (DONE, in stable).

CARRY-FORWARD (non-blocking, surfaces post-launch):
- ~/.zshrc still has the sed-pipe workaround for rvr-beta's broken completion script. Removable by either switching the eval line from `rvr-beta` to `rvr` (stable has the #111 fix), or by cutting v1.0.0-beta.4. Either way, low urgency since the workaround works.
- Test-runner swap to bun:test deferred to v1.1+ per project.bunMigrationScope. Don't pick up unless that's the explicit ask.

USER STATE: Long, productive session — full v1.0.0 launch from clean-slate-after-rebrand to stable in one sitting. Including one broken release (beta.2) that was caught and hot-fixed within minutes. Reverie v1.0.0 is live and functional.
